brief: Prioritise clearance work if any vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, as restricted airflow removes the cooling margin the unit relies on during sustained high ambient conditions [SOP-011]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, including the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
